profile.summary: Impact Capital Holdings Berhad, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the supply of information and communications technology hardware and software in Malaysia. The company is also involved in integration of information and communications technology (ICT) equipment and systems for critical infrastructure; and provision of ICT and other services. In addition, it provides renewable energy systems and related products and services. The company sells and markets its product through direct main and indirect complementary channels. It serves local and state government bodies, utility service providers, internet technology companies, and financial and merchant services providers. The company was formerly known as Impact Capital Holdings Sdn Bhd. and changed its name to Impact Capital Holdings Berhad in October 2025. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Kuching, Malaysia. Impact Capital Holdings Berhad operates as a subsidiary of Inspirasi Generasi Equiti Sdn. Bhd.
profile.zh: Impact Capital Holdings Berhad 是一家马来西亚公司，成立于2005年，总部位于古晋，通过子公司从事信息与通信技术硬件和软件的供应。公司前身为 Impact Capital Holdings Sdn Bhd，于2025年10月更名为现名，是 Inspirasi Generasi Equiti Sdn. Bhd. 的子公司。
lines: ICT硬件与软件供应：在马来西亚供应信息与通信技术硬件和软件。
ICT设备与系统集成：为关键基础设施集成信息与通信技术设备和系统。
ICT及其他服务：提供信息与通信技术服务及其他相关服务。
可再生能源系统：提供可再生能源系统及相关产品和服务。
销售渠道：通过直接主要渠道和间接补充渠道销售和推广产品，服务地方政府机构、公用事业服务商、互联网技术公司以及金融和商户服务提供商。
lines_en: ICT hardware and software supply: Supplies information and communications technology hardware and software in Malaysia.
ICT equipment and systems integration: Integrates ICT equipment and systems for critical infrastructure.
ICT and other services: Provides ICT and other related services.
Renewable energy systems: Provides renewable energy systems and related products and services.

Sales channels: Sells and markets products through direct main and indirect complementary channels, serving local and state government bodies, utility service providers, internet technology companies, and financial and merchant services providers.
